items.title: Translational control of microglial metabolism, inflammatory responses, and survival by the eIF4E-binding proteins.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Sara Bermudez; Jung-Hyun Choi; Niaz Mahmood; Jacob W Vogel; Hashem Almousa; Ziying Huang; Sung-Hoon Kim; Vivian Yuchan Zhu
items.abstract: In Alzheimer's disease (AD), activation of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway promotes microglial neuroprotective functions by engaging multiple cell receptors. However, the relevant downstream effectors are not fully understood. mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) promotes mRNA translation by phosphorylating and inactivating eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 and 2 (4E-BP1/2), which are expressed in microglia. 4E-BP1 levels in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) are elevated in AD and correlate with markers of microglial reactivity and disease progression. Using linear regression analysis, we found that elevated CSF 4E-BP1 levels strengthen the association between soluble TREM2 levels and neurodegeneration in amyloid-positive individuals. To investigate the underlying mechanism, we performed in vitro experiments demonstrating that amyloid-β inactivated 4E-BP1 in murine microglia. The mTOR-mediated inactivation is highly dependent on Spleen Tyrosine Kinase (SYK) signaling and repeated exposure to amyloid-β impaired this process, whereas prolonged exposure increased 4E-BP1 levels in microglia. Deletion of 4E-BP1/2 resulted in increased mitochondrial mass and oxidative phosphorylation, reduced pro-inflammatory signaling, and protected microglia from amyloid-induced apoptosis. Thus, impaired 4E-BP1 inactivation-due to reduced mTOR signaling or excess 4E-BP1-disrupts immune resolution, leading to metabolic exhaustion and microglial cell death. We identify the SYK-mTORC1-4E-BP1 signaling axis as a key regulator of microglial mitochondrial biogenesis and immune resolution in AD.

items.abstract_cn: 在阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 中，雷帕霉素机械靶点 (mTOR) 通路的激活通过与多个细胞受体结合来促进小胶质细胞的神经保护功能。然而，相关的下游效应器尚未完全了解。 mTOR 复合物 1 (mTORC1) 通过磷酸化和灭活小胶质细胞中表达的真核翻译起始因子 4E 结合蛋白 1 和 2 (4E-BP1/2) 来促进 mRNA 翻译。 AD 患者脑脊液 (CSF) 中的 4E-BP1 水平升高，并且与小胶质细胞反应性和疾病进展的标志物相关。通过线性回归分析，我们发现脑脊液 4E-BP1 水平升高增强了淀粉样蛋白阳性个体中可溶性 TREM2 水平与神经退行性变之间的关联。为了研究其潜在机制，我们进行了体外实验，证明淀粉样蛋白-β 使小鼠小胶质细胞中的 4E-BP1 失活。 mTOR 介导的失活高度依赖于脾酪氨酸激酶 (SYK) 信号传导，反复暴露于淀粉样蛋白-β 会损害这一过程，而长期暴露会增加小胶质细胞中的 4E-BP1 水平。 4E-BP1/2 的缺失导致线粒体质量和氧化磷酸化增加，促炎信号传导减少，并保护小胶质细胞免受淀粉样蛋白诱导的细胞凋亡。因此，由于 mTOR 信号传导减少或 4E-BP1 过量，4E-BP1 失活受损会破坏免疫分辨率，导致代谢衰竭和小胶质细胞死亡。我们确定 SYK-mTORC1-4E-BP1 信号轴是 AD 中小胶质细胞线粒体生物发生和免疫解决的关键调节因子。

items.title: Interhemispheric hygroma as a predictor of post-traumatic hydrocephalus after decompressive craniectomy: a phenotype-specific systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.journal: Journal of clinical neuroscience : official journal of the Neurosurgical Society of Australasia
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Post-traumatic hydrocephalus (PTH) is a recognized complication following decompressive craniectomy (DC) for traumatic brain injury (TBI). Subdural hygroma has been implicated as a potential risk factor; however, prior studies have been limited by heterogeneous definitions and lack of distinction between hygroma subtypes. The role of interhemispheric hygroma (IHH) as a specific predictor of hydrocephalus remains unclear. METHODS: We conducted a systematic review in accordance with PRISMA 2020 guidelines. We searched PubMed (MEDLINE), Cochrane, and Scopus from inception to March 2025. We included studies evaluating hydrocephalus following DC for TBI and reporting data on subdural hygroma. We adopted a phenotype-specific approach, focusing on IHH as the primary exposure and clinically significant hydrocephalus (shunt-dependent or clearly defined clinical hydrocephalus) as the outcome. We assessed study quality using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. We performed the meta-analysis using study-level 2 × 2 data, with fixed-effect and random-effects models for primary and sensitivity analyses, respectively. RESULTS: We included 14 studies comprising 1,621 patients in the qualitative synthesis. We included three studies with comparable definitions in the primary meta-analysis, demonstrating a strong association between IHH and hydrocephalus (pooled OR 6.75, 95% CI 3.4-13.41; I2 = 9.8%). Sensitivity analyses incorporating additional heterogeneous studies confirmed the association, although with a lower effect size and increased heterogeneity. Studies relying on radiological definitions alone were excluded from pooled analysis but showed similar trends. Across studies, incidence of hydrocephalus varied widely depending on outcome definitions. CONCLUSIONS: Interhemispheric hygroma is strongly associated with the development of clinically significant hydrocephalus following DC. A phenotype-specific analytical approach reduces heterogeneity and improves interpretability compared with prior studies. Recognition of IHH may facilitate early identification of patients at risk for PTH and support more targeted postoperative monitoring and management strategies.

items.title_cn: 半球间积水作为去骨瓣减压术后创伤后脑积水的预测因子：表型特异性系统评价和荟萃分析。
items.abstract_cn: 背景：创伤后脑积水（PTH）是创伤性脑损伤（TBI）去骨瓣减压术（DC）后公认的并发症。硬膜下积水被认为是一个潜在的危险因素；然而，先前的研究受到不同定义和湿气亚型之间缺乏区分的限制。半球间积水（IHH）作为脑积水的特异性预测因子的作用仍不清楚。方法：我们根据 PRISMA 2020 指南进行了系统评价。我们检索了 PubMed (MEDLINE)、Cochrane 和 Scopus，从最初到 2025 年 3 月。我们纳入了评估 DC 后脑积水的 TBI 的研究，并报告了硬膜下积水的数据。我们采用了表型特异性方法，重点关注 IHH 作为主要暴露，并以临床显着脑积水（分流依赖性或明确定义的临床脑积水）作为结果。我们使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估研究质量。我们使用研究级 2 × 2 数据进行荟萃分析，分别使用固定效应和随机效应模型进行主要分析和敏感性分析。结果：我们在定性综合中纳入了 14 项研究，涉及 1,621 名患者。我们在主要荟萃分析中纳入了具有可比定义的三项研究，证明 IHH 与脑积水之间存在很强的关联（汇总 OR 6.75，95% CI 3.4-13.41；I2 = 9.8%）。结合其他异质性研究的敏感性分析证实了这种关联，尽管效应量较小且异质性增加。仅依赖放射学定义的研究被排除在汇总分析之外，但显示出类似的趋势。在各项研究中，脑积水的发病率根据结果定义的不同而有很大差异。结论：半球间积水与 DC 后临床上显着的脑积水的发生密切相关。与之前的研究相比，表型特异性分析方法减少了异质性并提高了可解释性。 IHH 的识别可能有助于早期识别有 PTH 风险的患者，并支持更有针对性的术后监测和管理策略。

items.title: TREM2: friend or foe in glioma?
items.authors: Mekenzie M Peshoff; Dolores Hambardzumyan; Long-Jun Wu
items.abstract: Triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2 (TREM2) is a neuroimmune signaling hub involved in key cellular processes including microglial phagocytosis, chemotaxis, and inflammation. Dysregulation of TREM2 has been implicated in a variety of diseases, most notably in the innate immune response to neurodegenerative disorders and cancer. The TREM2 pathway plays a significant role in governing microglia phenotypic transitions in Alzheimer's disease, as well as in regulating tumor-associated macrophages' ability to modulate cytotoxic activity. However, TREM2's role can be dependent on experimental parameters and disease contexts. Due to its intricate involvement in related disorders and the myeloid-dominated microenvironment in brain tumors, TREM2 has emerged as a vital player to better understand neuroimmune contributions to central nervous system malignancies. This review critically evaluates TREM2's controversial function in gliomas, analyzes experimental and biological variables that may underlie divergent findings, and outlines important considerations for future investigations.

items.abstract_cn: 骨髓细胞表达的触发受体 2 (TREM2) 是一种神经免疫信号传导中枢，参与小胶质细胞吞噬作用、趋化性和炎症等关键细胞过程。 TREM2 的失调与多种疾病有关，尤其是对神经退行性疾病和癌症的先天免疫反应。 TREM2 通路在控制阿尔茨海默病中的小胶质细胞表型转变以及调节肿瘤相关巨噬细胞调节细胞毒活性的能力方面发挥着重要作用。然而，TREM2 的作用可能取决于实验参数和疾病背景。由于 TREM2 与相关疾病和脑肿瘤中以髓系为主的微环境有着复杂的关系，因此 TREM2 已成为更好地了解神经免疫对中枢神经系统恶性肿瘤的影响的重要参与者。这篇综述批判性地评估了 TREM2 在神经胶质瘤中的有争议的功能，分析了可能导致不同发现的实验和生物学变量，并概述了未来研究的重要考虑因素。

items.title: Extracellular matrix-derived matrikines as emerging modulators of neuroinflammation and central nervous system signaling.
items.authors: Emma C Creed; Mitchell Beckedorf; Samantha C Y Yudin; Fern L Deyholos; Andis Klegeris
items.abstract: Neuroinflammation underlies many neurodegenerative disorders and is orchestrated by interactions between microglia, astrocytes, and neurons. While cytokines, chemokines, and damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs) are established neuroimmune mediators, extracellular matrix (ECM)-derived protein fragments, collectively termed matrikines, have received little attention in the central nervous system (CNS). Emerging evidence suggests that matrikines constitute a distinct and functionally important class of neuroimmune modulators. This review focuses on six CNS-relevant matrikines: type I collagen-derived acetylated Pro-Gly-Pro (Ac-PGP) and Gly-His-Lys (GHK); laminin-derived Ile-Lys-Val-Ala-Val (IKVAV) and Tyr-Ile-Gly-Ser-Arg (YIGSR); elastin-derived Val-Gly-Val-Ala-Pro-Gly (VGVAPG); and endorepellin, corresponding to domain V of perlecan. We describe their generation, receptor interactions, and signaling properties, and summarize their established effects in peripheral tissues and the limited evidence for CNS-specific roles. Current findings indicate that CNS matrikines may arise by peripheral entry through a compromised blood-brain barrier (BBB), proteolysis of the BBB basement membrane, or local degradation of CNS interstitial matrix and perineuronal nets during injury or disease. Their CNS effects are highly context- and cell-specific, ranging from neuroprotection and enhanced neuronal survival to modulation of microglial and astrocytic functions, cell migration, autophagy, and direct neurotoxicity. Collectively, evidence supports matrikines as CNS signaling molecules that complement classical immune mediators. Of note, studies using human CNS cells and tissues remain largely absent and should be prioritized to assess translational relevance. Systematic profiling of CNS matrikines, combined with mechanistic studies of their cell-specific signaling, especially in human cells, may reveal novel biomarkers and therapeutic targets, offering new avenues for intervention in neurodegenerative and other neurological disorders.

items.abstract_cn: 神经炎症是许多神经退行性疾病的基础，是由小胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞和神经元之间的相互作用精心策划的。虽然细胞因子、趋化因子和损伤相关分子模式 (DAMP) 是已确定的神经免疫介质，但细胞外基质 (ECM) 衍生的蛋白质片段（统称为基质因子）在中枢神经系统 (CNS) 中很少受到关注。新的证据表明，matrikines 构成了一类独特且功能重要的神经免疫调节剂。本综述重点关注六种中枢神经系统相关的基质蛋白：I 型胶原衍生的乙酰化 Pro-Gly-Pro (Ac-PGP) 和 Gly-His-Lys (GHK)；层粘连蛋白衍生的 Ile-Lys-Val-Ala-Val (IKVAV) 和 Tyr-Ile-Gly-Ser-Arg (YIGSR)；弹性蛋白衍生的 Val-Gly-Val-Ala-Pro-Gly (VGVAPG)；和内皮素，对应基底膜蛋白聚糖的结构域 V。我们描述了它们的产生、受体相互作用和信号传导特性，并总结了它们在外周组织中的既定作用以及中枢神经系统特异性作用的有限证据。目前的研究结果表明，CNS matrikines 可能是通过受损的血脑屏障 (BBB) 进入外周、BBB 基底膜的蛋白水解或损伤或疾病期间 CNS 间质基质和神经周围网的局部降解而产生的。它们的中枢神经系统作用具有高度的背景和细胞特异性，范围从神经保护和增强神经元存活到调节小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞功能、细胞迁移、自噬和直接神经毒性。总的来说，有证据支持 matrikines 作为 CNS 信号分子来补充经典免疫介质。值得注意的是，使用人类中枢神经系统细胞和组织的研究仍然基本上不存在，应优先评估转化相关性。 CNS matrikines 的系统分析，结合其细胞特异性信号传导（尤其是人类细胞）的机制研究，可能会揭示新的生物标志物和治疗靶点，为干预神经退行性疾病和其他神经系统疾病提供新途径。

items.title: α-Catenin phosphorylation is tension-sensitive and supports epithelial barrier functions via afadin.
items.authors: Jeanne M Quinn; Phuong M Le; Anthea Weng; Annette S Flozak; S Sai Folmsbee; Erik Arroyo Colon; Raul Piseaux Aillon; Sonali I Jain
items.abstract: Zonula adherens junctions (zAJs) are spatially proximal to tight junctions (TJs), in a superstructure known as the apical junctional complex (AJC). A key component of the AJC is a circumferential ring of F-actin, but how actomyosin contractility drives AJC structure and epithelial barrier function is incompletely understood. Here, we show that a central mechanosensitive component of zAJ, α-catenin (α-cat), undergoes force-dependent phosphorylation in an unstructured linker region. This modification in turn primes the α-cat middle region for effector binding. We credential afadin, a TJ/AJ scaffold protein, as a mechanochemical binding partner of α-cat, identifying residues in α-cat required for binding. α-Cat phosphorylation and afadin binding support their co-enrichment at zAJ and barrier function. A mouse model that prevents α-cat phosphorylation is particularly detrimental to postnatal brain development, leading to hydrocephalus with junctional features similar to an afadin-binding mutant form of α-cat. These data support a model where α-cat integrates mechanical and chemical signals to progressively promote zAJ enrichment, effector recruitment, and barrier function.

items.title: Intraventricular clindamycin enhances interstitial brain fluid drainage and the blood-brain barrier after a traumatic brain injury.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Landon S Ashby; Megan G Crowe; Daveraj Chakravarty; Sanjeev Medam; Gabriel Frampton; Ayesha B Das; David A Hormuth; Thomas E Yankeelov
items.abstract: Despite advances in the acute clinical management of severe traumatic brain injuries (TBIs), treating injury-derived secondary pathogenesis remains challenging. We demonstrate intracerebroventricular (I.C.V.) administration of clindamycin alleviates TBI secondary pathogenesis in both focal and diffuse murine models of brain injury. I.C.V. administration of clindamycin increased the motility of ependymal cilia, which line the ventricles and spinal canal, by 30 to 60%, which correlated with interstitial brain fluid drainage through the cortex (r > 0.9 Pearson, n = 4 compounds tested). I.C.V. clindamycin treatment post-TBI also restored the blood-brain barrier (BBB), decreased lesion size, and lowered serum levels of glial fibrillary acidic protein by 2.8-fold. Consistent with these data, a novel objective recognition test revealed an improvement in recognition memory in brain-injured mice treated with clindamycin. These collective findings reveal a counterintuitive finding that I.C.V. clindamycin enhances drainage of toxins from the brain while simultaneously restoring the BBB, potentially providing a new solution for alleviating secondary pathogenesis in brain-injured patients.

items.title_cn: 脑室内注射克林霉素可增强脑外伤后间质脑液引流和血脑屏障。
items.abstract_cn: 尽管严重创伤性脑损伤（TBIs）的急性临床治疗取得了进展，但治疗损伤引起的继发性发病机制仍然具有挑战性。我们证明，在局灶性和弥漫性脑损伤小鼠模型中，脑室内 (I.C.V.) 给予克林霉素可减轻 TBI 继发性发病机制。 I.C.V.给予克林霉素可使脑室和椎管内的室管膜纤毛的运动性增加 30% 至 60%，这与通过皮质的间质脑液引流相关（r > 0.9 Pearson，n = 4 种测试化合物）。 I.C.V. TBI 后的克林霉素治疗还可以恢复血脑屏障 (BBB)、缩小病变大小并将神经胶质纤维酸性蛋白的血清水平降低 2.8 倍。与这些数据一致，一项新颖的客观识别测试显示，接受克林霉素治疗的脑损伤小鼠的识别记忆有所改善。这些集体发现揭示了一个违反直觉的发现：I.C.V.克林霉素可增强大脑中毒素的排出，同时恢复血脑屏障，这可能为减轻脑损伤患者的继发性发病机制提供新的解决方案。

items.title: Sonic hedgehog-matrix metalloproteinase crosstalk in neurovascular ageing and stroke: a potential mechanistic link.
items.authors: Priya Bindal; Paul R Kasher; Satoshi Ogawa
items.abstract: Neurovascular ageing is a major contributor to cerebrovascular vulnerability and poor stroke outcomes in older adults. Progressive deterioration of the neurovascular unit (NVU), driven by oxidative stress, neurovascular coupling dysfunction, blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption, inflammageing, cellular senescence, mitochondrial dysfunction, and impaired autophagy compromises neurovascular resilience and increases susceptibility to ischemic injury. Among the molecular pathways implicated in these processes, Sonic hedgehog (Shh) signaling and matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) are important regulators of neurovascular remodeling, BBB integrity, and post-stroke recovery. Although these pathways have largely been investigated independently, emerging evidence suggests potential bidirectional interactions between Shh signaling and MMP activity. In particular, Shh/Gli1 signaling has been associated with regulation of MMP-2 and MMP-9 in experimental models, whereas MMP-2 can disrupt SCUBE2, an extracellular regulator of Shh ligand presentation, providing a potential mechanism for reciprocal pathway modulation. This review examines the Shh-MMP axis as a potential mechanistic link between neurovascular ageing and ischemic vulnerability, integrating current evidence to evaluate how dysregulation of these pathways may contribute to BBB dysfunction, extracellular matrix remodeling, neuroinflammation, and impaired neurovascular repair. We further discuss the potential therapeutic implications of modulating the Shh-MMP axis to preserve neurovascular resilience and improve cerebrovascular outcomes in the ageing brain, while highlighting the importance of temporal and cell-specific targeting.

items.title_cn: 神经血管衰老和中风中的声波刺猬-基质金属蛋白酶串扰：潜在的机制联系。
items.abstract_cn: 神经血管老化是老年人脑血管脆弱性和中风预后不良的主要原因。由氧化应激、神经血管耦合功能障碍、血脑屏障（BBB）破坏、炎症、细胞衰老、线粒体功能障碍和自噬受损驱动的神经血管单元（NVU）进行性恶化，会损害神经血管的弹性并增加对缺血性损伤的易感性。在这些过程中涉及的分子途径中，Sonic Hedgehog (Shh) 信号传导和基质金属蛋白酶 (MMP) 是神经血管重塑、血脑屏障完整性和中风后恢复的重要调节因子。尽管这些通路在很大程度上已被独立研究，但新出现的证据表明 Shh 信号传导和 MMP 活性之间存在潜在的双向相互作用。特别是，在实验模型中，Shh/Gli1 信号传导与 MMP-2 和 MMP-9 的调节有关，而 MMP-2 可以破坏 SCUBE2（Shh 配体呈递的细胞外调节因子），为相互途径调节提供潜在机制。本综述探讨了 Shh-MMP 轴作为神经血管衰老和缺血性脆弱性之间潜在的机制联系，整合当前证据来评估这些通路的失调如何导致 BBB 功能障碍、细胞外基质重塑、神经炎症和神经血管修复受损。我们进一步讨论了调节Shh-MMP轴以保持神经血管弹性并改善衰老大脑的脑血管结果的潜在治疗意义，同时强调时间和细胞特异性靶向的重要性。

items.title: The Use of Nutritional Supplements as a Therapy for Spinal Cord Injury. A Narrative Review.
items.authors: Daniela Yazmin Velázquez-Colin; William Yahir Hernández-Tenorio; Alexis Brandon Cruz-Cruz; Maritza Estrada; Stefany Jeovanna Téllez-Reyes; Melchor Castro-Marín; Exsal Manuel Albores-Méndez; Ivan Ignacio-Mejía
items.abstract: AimTo evaluate the therapeutic potential of nutritional supplementation as a complementary strategy to mitigate secondary injury mechanisms and promote recovery in spinal cord injury (SCI).MethodsThis narrative review synthesizes current preclinical and clinical evidence on the role of micronutrients and macronutrients in SCI management, focusing on their mechanisms of action in neuroprotection, neuroregeneration, and functional recovery.ResultsSCI is a severe neurological condition characterized by long-term motor, sensory, and autonomic dysfunction, largely driven by secondary injury processes such as oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, excitotoxicity, and apoptosis. Evidence indicates that micronutrients-including vitamins A, B complex, C, D, and E, as well as trace elements such as selenium, zinc, copper, and magnesium-exert neuroprotective effects by modulating inflammatory responses, reducing oxidative damage, supporting mitochondrial function, and enhancing myelination. Additionally, macronutrients such as carbohydrates, amino acids, omega-3 fatty acids, and bioactive compounds including alpha-lipoic acid, N-acetylcysteine, and acetyl-L-carnitine contribute to axonal regeneration, metabolic support, and functional recovery. Collectively, these nutrients target key pathophysiological pathways involved in secondary SCI progressionConclusionsNutritional supplementation represents a promising, safe, and accessible adjunctive strategy to enhance neuroprotection and improve outcomes in individuals with SCI. However, further research is required to optimize dosing, timing, and combinatorial approaches to maximize therapeutic efficacy.
items.title_en: The Use of Nutritional Supplements as a Therapy for Spinal Cord Injury. A Narrative Review.
items.title_cn: 使用营养补充剂治疗脊髓损伤。叙事评论。
items.abstract_cn: 目的 评估营养补充作为缓解继发性损伤机制和促进脊髓损伤 (SCI) 恢复的补充策略的治疗潜力。方法这篇叙述性综述综合了目前关于微量营养素和常量营养素在 SCI 管理中的作用的临床前和临床证据，重点关注它们在神经保护、神经再生和功能恢复中的作用机制。结果 SCI 是一种严重的神经系统疾病，其特征是长期运动、感觉和自主神经功能障碍，很大程度上是由氧化应激、氧化应激等继发性损伤过程驱动的。神经炎症、兴奋性毒性和细胞凋亡。有证据表明，微量营养素（包括维生素 A、复合维生素 B、C、D 和 E）以及硒、锌、铜和镁等微量元素通过调节炎症反应、减少氧化损伤、支持线粒体功能和增强髓鞘形成来发挥神经保护作用。此外，大量营养素（例如碳水化合物、氨基酸、omega-3 脂肪酸）和生物活性化合物（包括 α-硫辛酸、N-乙酰半胱氨酸和乙酰-L-肉碱）有助于轴突再生、代谢支持和功能恢复。总的来说，这些营养素针对参与继发性 SCI 进展的关键病理生理学途径。结论营养补充剂是一种有前途、安全且易于使用的辅助策略，可增强 SCI 患者的神经保护和改善预后。然而，还需要进一步研究来优化剂量、时间和组合方法，以最大限度地提高治疗效果。

items.title: Gut microbiota vesicle reprogramming by
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Zimu Zhang; Hanfei Gong; Zhenzhen Zhang; Ping Ying; Chao Zhang; Wenjun Xu; Lingyi Kong
items.abstract: Respiratory infections remain a major global health challenge, further compounded by antibiotic resistance. Among these, mycoplasmal pneumonia represents a particularly prevalent and refractory form. Here, using targeted enzymatic fragmentation combined with multidimensional NMR analysis, we resolved the structure of a homogeneous Ganoderma lucidum polysaccharide, GLFP2, and identified β-(1→6)-linked galactosyl motifs as key structural features. Despite minimal systemic absorption, oral GLFP2 alleviated mycoplasmal pneumonia in mice. Instead, GLFP2 reshaped the gut microbiota and functionally reprogrammed gut microbiota-derived extracellular vesicles (GMEVs), whose transplantation alone was sufficient to confer pulmonary protection. Orally administered GMEVs remained bioactive, showed systemic exposure, associated with the lung, and were preferentially taken up by alveolar macrophages. These vesicles activated AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) signaling, suppressed the S100A8/A9 inflammatory axis, and limited neutrophil-driven immunopathology. Collectively, these findings identify microbiota-derived vesicles as effectors of gut-lung communication and use a defined polysaccharide to uncover a remote protective mechanism against pneumonia.

items.title: Subacute administration of human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells is associated with neurobehavioral improvement, myeloid immune modulation, and altered HMGB1 dynamics after experimental ischemic stroke.
items.authors: Yuki Takeda; Yoji Kuramoto; Shoichiro Tsuji; Nobutaka Doe; Kenichi Yamahara; Shinichi Yoshimura
items.abstract: Cell therapy using human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUCMSCs) is attracting attention as a promising treatment strategy for ischemic stroke. This study investigated the therapeutic effects and associated biological changes following hUCMSC administration during the subacute phase using a mouse model of permanent middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO). Based on our previous findings showing an increase in CD163-positive brain immune cells after hUCMSC administration, we hypothesized that subacute hUCMSC treatment would be associated with changes in myeloid immune responses and high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) dynamics. hUCMSCs were administered intravenously two weeks after MCAO induction. Ischemic brain and systemic immune responses were evaluated at the 3rd, 4th, and 5th weeks post-MCAO using flow cytometry, RT-qPCR, immunohistochemistry, terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick-end labeling (TUNEL), Evans Blue assay, Western blotting, and ELISA. Neurobehavioral outcomes were also assessed during the subacute and chronic phases after MCAO. Subacute hUCMSC administration was associated with improved neurobehavioral outcomes after ischemic stroke. Brain immune-cell analyses showed treatment-associated changes in CD163/CD204 co-expression and intracellular HMGB1 accumulation, while peripheral myeloid populations also exhibited changes in CD163 expression within Ly6C subsets. These findings indicate that neurobehavioral improvement following hUCMSC administration was accompanied by local and systemic myeloid immune changes and altered intracellular HMGB1 dynamics.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: TSPO-PET binding in vivo reflects increased phagocytic microglia at post mortem in people with frontotemporal dementia.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Davi S Vontobel; Kei Onn Lai; Mehtap Bacioglu; George Nolan; Daniel C Maddison; Amelie Adamski; Julia Goddard; Noah L Shapiro
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Brain inflammation is a key feature of frontotemporal dementia (FTD). Positron emission tomography (PET) of the 18 kDa translocator protein (TSPO) is widely used as an in vivo proxy for neuroinflammation, but whether the elevated signal reflects microglial, astrocytic or vascular pathology remains controversial, and this has not previously been resolved in FTD using matched ante mortem imaging and post-mortem tissue. We paired ante mortem [11C]PK11195 TSPO-PET with quantitative post-mortem neuropathology in 10 individuals with FTD (5 FTLD-tau, 5 FTLD-TDP) and 5 age- and sex-matched controls, combining CD68 immunohistochemistry across 17 brain regions, multiplex immunofluorescence pairing TSPO with microglial/macrophagic (IBA1, CD68), astrocytic (GFAP) and endothelial (CD31) markers in three frontotemporal cortical regions, and three-dimensional single-cell reconstruction of individual microglia. CD68 area fraction was elevated in FTD relative to controls, predominantly in white matter, and was positively associated with regional TSPO-PET-binding potential across the cohort (β = 8.66, P < 0.001), with comparable slopes in FTLD-tau and FTLD-TDP. Total tissue TSPO-area fraction was likewise increased in FTD and tracked regional PET binding in two independently processed slide sets. Of the four cell-type markers, only the CD68-TSPO co-localised fraction was positively associated with the PET signal (β = +0.0041, P = 0.015, PFDR = 0.062), with null or negative associations for IBA1, GFAP and CD31. At single-cell resolution, IBA1+ microglia that were also CD68+ carried more absolute TSPO and were larger than CD68- microglia, without an increase in the TSPO fraction of cell volume. The elevated TSPO-PET signal in FTD, therefore, likely reflects an increased burden of CD68+ phagocytic microglia rather than TSPO expression in other cell types, supporting TSPO-PET as a microglial-burden biomarker across both FTLD-tau and FTLD-TDP.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 脑部炎症是额颞叶痴呆 (FTD) 的一个关键特征。 18 kDa 易位蛋白 (TSPO) 的正电子发射断层扫描 (PET) 被广泛用作体内神经炎症的替代指标，但升高的信号是否反映小胶质细胞、星形细胞或血管病理学仍存在争议，并且之前在使用匹配的死前成像和死后组织的 FTD 中尚未解决这一问题。我们将死前 [11C]PK11195 TSPO-PET 与定量死后神经病理学配对，对 10 名 FTD 个体（5 名 FTLD-tau、5 名 FTLD-TDP）和 5 名年龄和性别匹配的对照进行配对，结合 17 个脑区的 CD68 免疫组织化学，将 TSPO 与小胶质细胞/巨噬细胞（IBA1、CD68）配对的多重免疫荧光，三个额颞皮质区域的星形细胞（GFAP）和内皮细胞（CD31）标记物，以及单个小胶质细胞的三维单细胞重建。相对于对照组，FTD 中的 CD68 面积分数升高（主要在白质中），并且与整个队列中的区域 TSPO-PET 结合潜力呈正相关（β = 8.66，P < 0.001），FTLD-tau 和 FTLD-TDP 的斜率相当。 FTD 中的总组织 TSPO 面积分数同样增加，并在两个独立处理的载玻片组中跟踪区域 PET 结合。在四种细胞类型标记中，只有 CD68-TSPO 共定位部分与 PET 信号呈正相关（β = +0.0041，P = 0.015，PFDR = 0.062），与 IBA1、GFAP 和 CD31 呈零相关或负相关。在单细胞分辨率下，同时也是 CD68+ 的 IBA1+ 小胶质细胞携带更多的绝对 TSPO，并且比 CD68- 小胶质细胞更大，但细胞体积的 TSPO 分数没有增加。因此，FTD 中 TSPO-PET 信号升高可能反映了 CD68+ 吞噬小胶质细胞负担的增加，而不是其他细胞类型中 TSPO 表达的增加，这支持 TSPO-PET 作为 FTLD-tau 和 FTLD-TDP 中小胶质细胞负担的生物标志物。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Prevalence of alpha-synuclein seeding activity in the Olfactory Mucosa following SARS-CoV-2 infection: results from a pilot study.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Beatrice Heim; Klaus Seppi; Nicolas De Cleene; Matilde Bongianni; Erika Bronzato; Clancy Cerejo; Frank Jagusch; Philipp Kindl
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Olfactory dysfunction (OD) is a hallmark of SARS-CoV-2-infection where it is believed to result from neuroinflammation induced by viral invasion via the olfactory mucosa (OM). Hyposmia also affects the majority of patients with Parkinson's disease (PD) where it is caused by α-synuclein (aSyn) pathology in the olfactory system, and aSyn-seeding-activity can be detected in the OM using aSyn-seeding-amplification-assays (aSyn-SAA). The present pilot study aimed to investigate whether SARS-CoV-2-infection induces local aSyn-misfolding and -aggregation in OM samples using aSyn-SAA. We conducted an observational study including PD patients (n = 51), individuals with a history of documented symptomatic SARS-CoV-2-infection (post-COVID; n = 95), and healthy controls (HC; n = 42). Post-COVID-participants were stratified based on persistent OD (COVID+OD; n = 42) or normal olfaction (COVID-OD; n = 53) using Sniffin'-Sticks-Identification (SSI) and -Discrimination (SSD) tests. OM samples were obtained by ENT specialists and analyzed by aSyn-SAA at the University of Verona. Clinical phenotyping included MDS-UPDRS, MoCA, and the Innsbruck-RBD-Inventory. OM-SAA positivity rates were significantly different between PD and both post-COVID-participants and HCs (80.4% vs 24.2% vs 11.9%; p < 0.001). Within the post-COVID-group, positivity rates were higher in COVID+OD vs COVID-OD (35.7% vs 15.1%; p = 0.030), and COVID+OD differed from HC (p = 0.030), while COVID-OD did not (p = 0.65). Among post-COVID-participants, aSyn-SAA positivity was associated with lower SSI (p = 0.007) and SSD (p < 0.001) scores, but not with MDS-UPDRS, MoCA, or RBD measures. OM-SAA-positivity was enriched among individuals with persistent post-COVID-OD and correlated with olfactory impairment. These findings support the hypothesis that neuroinflammation following SARS-COV-2-infection might promote local aSyn-aggregation. The biological and prognostic relevance of OM-SAA positivity is unknown and needs further prospective investigation.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: TMEM106B risk converges on C-terminal fragment homeostasis: genetics, mechanisms and therapy.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Miranda Lastra Osua; Jolien Perneel; Cristina T Vicente; Rosa Rademakers
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: TMEM106B is a genetic modifier influencing susceptibility to multiple neurodegenerative disorders, including frontotemporal lobar degeneration with TDP-43 pathology (FTLD-TDP), Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy, as well as contributing to healthy brain aging and neuronal reserve. The gene harbours single nucleotide polymorphisms and structural variants that define risk and protective haplotypes, and despite extensive efforts to identify the functional variant within these haplotypes, consensus remains elusive. In this review, we synthesize current knowledge of TMEM106B genetics from human cohorts and mechanistic studies, highlighting how variants may influence its regulatory network and protein levels, with an emphasis on its aggregation-prone C-terminal domain. We further integrate evidence on the roles of TMEM106B within the endo-lysosomal system and beyond, including insights into protein structure, posttranslational modifications, interactors, proteolytic processing, and fibril formation. These findings are contextualized using data from mouse and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) models, highlighting current gaps in the available models and the advances required to study its functions and cleavage. Finally, we explore therapeutic strategies targeting TMEM106B, focusing on modulation of expression, specific functional pathways, and fibril formation.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: TREM2: friend or foe in glioma?
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Mekenzie M Peshoff; Dolores Hambardzumyan; Long-Jun Wu
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2 (TREM2) is a neuroimmune signaling hub involved in key cellular processes including microglial phagocytosis, chemotaxis, and inflammation. Dysregulation of TREM2 has been implicated in a variety of diseases, most notably in the innate immune response to neurodegenerative disorders and cancer. The TREM2 pathway plays a significant role in governing microglia phenotypic transitions in Alzheimer's disease, as well as in regulating tumor-associated macrophages' ability to modulate cytotoxic activity. However, TREM2's role can be dependent on experimental parameters and disease contexts. Due to its intricate involvement in related disorders and the myeloid-dominated microenvironment in brain tumors, TREM2 has emerged as a vital player to better understand neuroimmune contributions to central nervous system malignancies. This review critically evaluates TREM2's controversial function in gliomas, analyzes experimental and biological variables that may underlie divergent findings, and outlines important considerations for future investigations.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 骨髓细胞表达的触发受体 2 (TREM2) 是一种神经免疫信号传导中枢，参与小胶质细胞吞噬作用、趋化性和炎症等关键细胞过程。 TREM2 的失调与多种疾病有关，尤其是对神经退行性疾病和癌症的先天免疫反应。 TREM2 通路在控制阿尔茨海默病中的小胶质细胞表型转变以及调节肿瘤相关巨噬细胞调节细胞毒活性的能力方面发挥着重要作用。然而，TREM2 的作用可能取决于实验参数和疾病背景。由于 TREM2 与相关疾病和脑肿瘤中以髓系为主的微环境有着复杂的关系，因此 TREM2 已成为更好地了解神经免疫对中枢神经系统恶性肿瘤的影响的重要参与者。这篇综述批判性地评估了 TREM2 在神经胶质瘤中的有争议的功能，分析了可能导致不同发现的实验和生物学变量，并概述了未来研究的重要考虑因素。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Identification of candidate markers for the isolation of neuron-specific extracellular vesicles.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Dmitry Ter-Ovanesyan; Sara Whiteman; Tal Gilboa; Emma J K Kowal; Wendy Trieu; Siddharth Iyer; Bogdan Budnik; Clarissa May Babila
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are present in biofluids and may be useful biomarkers to non-invasively monitor brain cells, but isolating cell type-specific EVs remains challenging. Here we introduce an approach to immuno-isolate EVs from neurons and glia based on protein surface markers. We first selected transmembrane proteins suitable as cell type-specific EV markers based on gene expression and EV proteomic data. We developed a high-purity EV isolation method and cataloged the proteins present on EVs in human cerebrospinal fluid and plasma. We then computationally identified cell type-specific candidate markers for isolating EVs from neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes and microglia. Using ultrasensitive immunoassays against several predicted neuron-specific proteins, we confirmed one marker, NRXN3, as present on EVs in cerebrospinal fluid and plasma. Finally, we developed efficient EV immuno-isolation methods and applied them to isolate NRXN3+ EVs. Our work provides a general methodology for the isolation of cell type-specific EVs, advancing the goal of using EVs to study brain diseases.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 细胞外囊泡 (EV) 存在于生物液中，可能是非侵入性监测脑细胞的有用生物标志物，但分离细胞类型特异性的 EV 仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍一种基于蛋白质表面标记从神经元和神经胶质细胞中免疫分离 EV 的方法。我们首先根据基因表达和 EV 蛋白质组数据选择适合作为细胞类型特异性 EV 标记的跨膜蛋白。我们开发了一种高纯度 EV 分离方法，并对人脑脊液和血浆中 EV 上存在的蛋白质进行了分类。然后，我们通过计算确定了细胞类型特异性候选标记，用于从神经元、星形胶质细胞、少突胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中分离 EV。使用针对几种预测的神经元特异性蛋白的超灵敏免疫测定，我们确认了一种标记物 NRXN3 存在于脑脊液和血浆中的 EV 上。最后，我们开发了高效的 EV 免疫分离方法并将其应用于分离 NRXN3+ EV。我们的工作为分离细胞类型特异性 EV 提供了通用方法，推进了使用 EV 研究脑疾病的目标。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Microglial NUS1 deficiency drives dopaminergic neurodegeneration through intercellular iron dysregulation in Parkinson's disease models.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Lele Liu; Yan Hong; Xiying Wang; Xiurong Huang; Yanni Ma; Rui Wang; Qian Sun; Hongyang Sun
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The selective loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta is a defining feature of Parkinson's disease (PD), yet its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. NUS1, which encodes neurite outgrowth inhibitor-B receptor (NgBR), was recently identified as a PD risk gene. Here we show that NgBR is highly expressed in microglia, where its deficiency drives progressive PD-like motor deficits and dopaminergic neurodegeneration via the LCN2-SLC22A17 iron-transport axis in mice. NgBR deficiency in mouse and human microglia triggers endoplasmic reticulum stress and PERK-ATF4-NUPR1 signaling, which preferentially induces LCN2-mediated iron efflux over cytokine release. Subsequently, microglia-derived iron-loaded Holo-LCN2, but not iron-free Apo-LCN2, is internalized by SLC22A17, a receptor highly expressed in dopaminergic neurons, leading to iron overload and ferroptosis. Pharmacological inhibition of LCN2-SLC22A17 axis or ferroptosis alleviated dopaminergic neuron loss and PD-like symptoms caused by microglial NgBR deficiency in vitro and in vivo. Our findings identify disrupted intercellular iron homeostasis as a pathological driver of PD and highlight the LCN2-SLC22A17 axis as a potential therapeutic target.

top_journal_neuroscience.title_cn: 在帕金森病模型中，小胶质细胞 NUS1 缺陷通过细胞间铁失调驱动多巴胺能神经变性。
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 黑质致密部多巴胺能神经元的选择性丧失是帕金森病（PD）的一个决定性特征，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。 NUS1 编码神经突生长抑制剂 B 受体 (NgBR)，最近被确定为 PD 风险基因。在这里，我们发现 NgBR 在小胶质细胞中高度表达，其缺陷通过小鼠的 LCN2-SLC22A17 铁转运轴驱动进行性 PD 样运动缺陷和多巴胺能神经变性。小鼠和人类小胶质细胞中的 NgBR 缺陷会触发内质网应激和 PERK-ATF4-NUPR1 信号传导，从而优先诱导 LCN2 介导的铁流出而不是细胞因子释放。随后，小胶质细胞来源的载铁 Holo-LCN2（而非无铁 Apo-LCN2）被 SLC22A17（一种在多巴胺能神经元中高度表达的受体）内化，导致铁过载和铁死亡。 LCN2-SLC22A17 轴或铁死亡的药理抑制可减轻体外和体内小胶质细胞 NgBR 缺乏引起的多巴胺能神经元损失和 PD 样症状。我们的研究结果将细胞间铁稳态破坏确定为 PD 的病理驱动因素，并强调 LCN2-SLC22A17 轴作为潜在的治疗靶点。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: KCNH1 variants associated with neurodevelopmental disorders exhibit prominent gain of function.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Christopher H Thompson; Christine Q Simmons; Isabella K He; Nirvani P Jairam; Reshma R Desai; Esther Cha; Alexandra E Hong; Jean-Marc DeKeyser
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Pathogenic variants in KCNH1, encoding the human ether-á-go-go voltage-gated potassium channel (EAG1, KV10.1), are associated with the neurodevelopmental disorders Temple-Baraitser syndrome (TBS), Zimmermann-Laband syndrome (ZLS), epileptic encephalopathy, and other undefined neurodevelopmental disorders. Investigating the functional consequences of KCNH1 variants can provide information about molecular and cellular pathophysiological mechanisms and help guide therapeutic directions. In this study, we determined the functional properties of 26 disease-associated KCNH1 variants including three recurrent and six that were previously unpublished. Findings were compared to the wildtype (WT) channel along with six rare population variants. Our approach used automated patch clamp recording of heterologously expressed KCNH1 variants in both the homozygous state (variant alone) and the clinically-relevant heterozygous state (variant co-expressed with WT channels). We also examined the impact of alternative splice isoforms on functional consequences of specific variants. We demonstrated that the majority of disease-associated KCNH1 variants exhibit features consistent with gain-of-function including hyperpolarized voltage-dependence of activation, accelerated activation kinetics, or both that promote hyperpolarization of the resting membrane potential. By contrast, one unique variant discovered previously in an autism cohort had a depolarized voltage-dependence of activation and was associated with a depolarized resting potential in cells. Pharmacological testing of KCNH1 variants demonstrated differences in potency for channel block by imipramine and an investigational non-selective potassium channel blocker (LY97241) for specific variants. Collectively, our findings support gain-of-function as the most common, albeit not exclusive, molecular mechanism underlying KCNH1-related disorders and suggest opportunities for potential therapeutic drug repurposing strategies for these conditions.

top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: KCNH1 编码人 ether-á-go-go 电压门控钾通道 (EAG1、KV10.1) 的致病性变异与神经发育障碍 Temple-Baraitser 综合征 (TBS)、Zimmermann-Laband 综合征 (ZLS)、癫痫性脑病和其他未定义的神经发育障碍相关。研究 KCNH1 变异的功能后果可以提供有关分子和细胞病理生理机制的信息，并有助于指导治疗方向。在这项研究中，我们确定了 26 种与疾病相关的 KCNH1 变异的功能特性，其中包括 3 种复发变异和 6 种之前未发表的变异。研究结果与野生型 (WT) 通道以及六种稀有种群变体进行了比较。我们的方法使用自动膜片钳记录纯合状态（单独变体）和临床相关杂合状态（与 WT 通道共表达的变体）异源表达的 KCNH1 变体。我们还研究了选择性剪接亚型对特定变体功能后果的影响。我们证明，大多数与疾病相关的 KCNH1 变体表现出与功能获得一致的特征，包括激活的超极化电压依赖性、加速激活动力学或两者均促进静息膜电位的超极化。相比之下，之前在自闭症队列中发现的一种独特变异具有去极化激活电压依赖性，并且与细胞中去极化静息电位相关。 KCNH1 变体的药理学测试表明，丙咪嗪和正在研究的非选择性钾通道阻滞剂 (LY97241) 对特定变体的通道阻断效力存在差异。总的来说，我们的研究结果支持功能获得是 KCNH1 相关疾病最常见（尽管不是唯一）的分子机制，并为这些疾病的潜在治疗药物重新利用策略提供了机会。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk in LGI1-antibody encephalitis.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Sudarshini Ramanathan; John Soltys; Sophia Michael; Samuel V Mackrill; Jonathan Cleaver; Robyn Williams; Mateusz Makuch; Patrick Waters
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Leucine-rich glioma-inactivated-1 antibody encephalitis (LGI1-Ab-E) is a common and immunotherapy-responsive form of encephalitis. However, it is not known which immunotherapy regimens improve short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk. Further, it is not known if the widely-utilised modified Rankin Scale (mRS) accurately captures quality of life (QoL) in LGI1-Ab-E, complicating disability measurements and interpretation of immunotherapy responses. A multicentre, international, real-world comparative analysis of patients with LGI1-Ab-E. Retrospective data from patient records evaluated short-term seizure and cognitive outcomes, 1-6 year disability, and future relapse risk associations, by integrating demographics, clinical features investigations and exposures to immunotherapies and antiseizure medications (ASMs). Patient- and neurologist-rated QoL assessments were used to establish an evidence-based mRS threshold for defining clinically significant disability. Cox proportional hazard models, Anderson-Gill, and generalised linear mixed-effects models were employed. 181 patients were included, with median age at onset 63 years (range 23 - 92); 122/181 (67%) were male. Short-term outcomes, evaluated at both five and ten weeks post-treatment initiation, identified exposure to immunotherapies associated with seizure resolution (OR = 13.97, 95%CI = 6.10-32.01; p < 0.0001 and OR = 8.53, 95%CI = 4.14-17.55; p < 0.0001, respectively), notably with corticosteroids, plasma exchange and rituximab, but not ASMs, intravenous immunoglobulins or steroid sparing agents. Conversely, seizure recurrence was observed after discontinuation of oral prednisolone, but not other immunotherapies or ASMs (OR = 39.53, 95%CI = 12.70-122.20, p < 0.0001). To evaluate longer-term disability, first, mRS scores were calibrated using QoL assessments: this identified a significant increase in patient-rated disability at mRS score of 2. Hence, using mRS 0-1 as a favourable outcome, we identified worse mRS at nadir associated with greater one-year disability (OR = 2.56, 95%CI = 1.56-4.20, p = 0.0003), and each month of delayed immunotherapy associated with a 16% increased risk of disability (HR = 1.16, 95%CI = 1.06-1.35, p = 0.004). Additionally, absence of immunotherapy associated both with greater one-year disability (OR = 5.67; 95% CI 1.19-26.54, p = 0.03) and a relapsing course (OR = 7.64, 95%CI = 2.51-21.77, p = 0.0002). Both a relapsing course, observed in 38% of patients, and the number of relapses associated with step-wise worsening of disability and QoL-outcomes. Rituximab exposure was the only identified clinical factor associated with reduced future relapse risk, by 93% (HR = 0.07, 95%CI = 0.01-0.48, p = 0.002). Persistent serum LGI1-IgMs, but not LGI1-IgGs, at one-year, associated with future relapses (HR = 11.69, 95%CI = 1.58-145.80, p = 0.02). Distinctive clinical factors and select immunotherapies, particularly intravenous methylprednisolone and plasma exchange, but not ASMs, associated with favourable short-term outcomes, patient-centric longer-term disability and relapses in LGI1-Ab-E. Our findings provide evidence-based disability thresholds, highlight novel prognostic biomarkers, and pragmatically guide LGI1-Ab-E care, pending randomized clinical trials.

global_hot_topics.title: Single-arm feasibility trial of manualized outpatient morita therapy for panic disorder with agoraphobia.
global_hot_topics.journal: PCN reports : psychiatry and clinical neurosciences
global_hot_topics.authors: Kiwako Yokoyama; Daisuke Yamaichi; Shigetsugu Nakao; Mitsuhiro Nakamura; Hiroyuki Uchida; Hidehito Niimura
global_hot_topics.abstract: AIM: This single-arm feasibility trial evaluated the feasibility and safety of a manualized outpatient Morita therapy (MT) program for patients with panic disorder (PD) and agoraphobia in routine psychiatric care, and explored preliminary signals of symptom change. METHODS: Ten outpatients with PD and agoraphobia were enrolled in a 12-session manualized MT program. Feasibility outcomes included retention, attendance, and therapist adherence. Exploratory outcomes were the changes in scores of the Panic and Agoraphobia Scale (PAS), the Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale-7 (GAD-7), the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9), and the Short Form-36 Health Survey (SF-36), assessed from baseline to the 6-month follow-up. Data were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models. RESULTS: Feasibility criteria were met. The completion rate was 90%, with a mean attendance of 11.6/12 sessions. Therapists reported high manual fidelity and usability. Exploratory analyses showed improvements in PAS (Hedges' g = 1.53, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.57-2.45) at 6-month follow-up, GAD-7 (g = 1.24, 95% CI 0.38-2.06), PHQ-9 (g = 1.05, 95% CI 0.25-1.80), and the Mental Component Summary of SF-36 (g = 1.71, 95% CI 0.68-2.70). The Role/Social Component Summary of SF-36 improved at post-treatment (g = 0.82, 95% CI 0.09-1.51) but not at follow-up (g = 0.45, 95% CI -0.19-1.06). No significant changes were observed in the Physical Component Summary of SF-36 (g = -0.14, 95% CI -0.72-0.46). CONCLUSION: Manualized outpatient MT appears feasible and safe for patients with PD and agoraphobia. Preliminary effects on symptoms warrant confirmation in randomized controlled trials.

global_hot_topics.title_cn: 手动门诊森田疗法治疗广场恐惧症恐慌症的单臂可行性试验。
global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 目的：这项单臂可行性试验评估了常规精神科护理中针对惊恐障碍（PD）和广场恐惧症患者的手动门诊森田疗法（MT）计划的可行性和安全性，并探索了症状变化的初步信号。方法：10 名患有 PD 和广场恐惧症的门诊患者参加了为期 12 次的手动 MT 项目。可行性结果包括保留率、出勤率和治疗师依从性。探索性结果是恐慌和广场恐惧症量表 (PAS)、广泛性焦虑症量表 7 (GAD-7)、患者健康问卷 9 (PHQ-9) 和简表 36 健康调查 (SF-36) 评分的变化，从基线到 6 个月的随访进行评估。使用线性混合效应模型分析数据。结果：满足可行性标准。完成率为90%，平均出席人数为11.6/12节。治疗师报告了高手动保真度和可用性。探索性分析显示，6 个月随访时，PAS（Hedges g = 1.53，95% CI 0.57-2.45）、GAD-7（g = 1.24，95% CI 0.38-2.06）、PHQ-9（g = 1.05，95% CI 0.25-1.80）和精神状态均有所改善。 SF-36 的成分摘要（g = 1.71，95% CI 0.68-2.70）。 SF-36 的角色/社会成分总结在治疗后有所改善（g = 0.82，95% CI 0.09-1.51），但在随访中没有改善（g = 0.45，95% CI -0.19-1.06）。 SF-36 的物理成分摘要中未观察到显着变化（g = -0.14，95% CI -0.72-0.46）。结论：手动门诊 MT 对于 PD 和广场恐惧症患者来说似乎可行且安全。对症状的初步影响需要随机对照试验的证实。

global_hot_topics.title: FMOD marks a low-malignancy epithelial state in prostate cancer: an ECM-related prognostic signature with single-cell and functional validation.
global_hot_topics.authors: Zhen Li; Xinyang Cai; Yichi Zhang; Ning Pan; Jianjun Luo; Yuanwei Li; Xi Guo
global_hot_topics.abstract: Extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling promotes prostate cancer progression, while the prognostic value and cellular context of ECM-related genes (ERGs) remain unclear. A 4-gene ERG signature for disease-free interval prediction was built using TCGA-PRAD data, and the hub gene Fibromodulin (FMOD) was validated in an external cohort via scRNA-seq, bulk deconvolution and siRNA knockdown. The signature stratified patient prognosis, and FMOD exerted the strongest protective effect. Despite higher bulk expression in tumor tissues, FMOD predicted better clinical outcomes. FMOD was enriched in a low-chromosomal-instability, low-proliferation epithelial subpopulation with enhanced stromal-immune crosstalk, and FMOD knockdown boosted cancer cell proliferation and colony formation. FMOD identifies a low-malignancy epithelial state linked to favorable prostate cancer prognosis, supporting cell state-resolved validation of ECM-related prognostic biomarkers.

global_hot_topics.title: Glioblastoma immune landscape remodeling following treatment with CD70-targeted CAR-T cells.
global_hot_topics.authors: Alexandros Kourtesakis; Dennis Alexander Agardy; Clara Tejido Dierssen; Ling Hai; Dirk Carsten Frieder Hoffmann; Normann Mussnig; Ralph Sinn; Manuel Fischer
global_hot_topics.abstract: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cell therapy has shown limited efficacy in glioblastoma (GB), largely because of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). We have previously demonstrated that the ligand-based mCD70-directed construct mCAR27 specifically eliminates CD70⁺ GB cells in vitro, and induces durable tumor remission with prolonged survival in a syngeneic model of orthotopic GB. Despite the therapeutic promise of CD70 as a GB CAR-T cell target, the impact of CD70-directed CAR-T cells on the brain tumor immune landscape after target interception remains unexplored. Here, we independently confirmed a tumorigenic role for CD70 in murine GB by performing bulk RNA sequencing and in vivo experiments. Next, we applied single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) to decipher the transcriptome of GB-infiltrating immune cells in immunocompetent mice bearing CD70+ GB after intratumoral mCAR27 therapy. CAR-T cell treatment expanded adoptively transferred cells and was associated with increased endogenous Cd8⁺ T-cell infiltration, alongside a reduction in immunosuppressive populations, including Tregs and anti-inflammatory M2-like macrophages, but also subsets of dendritic and natural-killer cells. CD70 expression was detected on multiple GB-infiltrating immune subsets, notably Tregs and M2-like macrophages. Transcriptionally, mCAR27-mediated GB remission led to a coordinated downregulation of type-I interferon-stimulated genes and immunosuppressive mediators such as Arg1, Tgfbi, Cd274, Pdcd1lg2 and Lag3, coupled with upregulation of genes involved in inflammatory resolution, findings consistent with attenuation of GB-derived inflammatory stress and immunosuppression. Collectively, we showcase that CD70-directed CAR-T cell therapy remodels the post-treatment immune landscape towards resolution of inflammation and reduced immunosuppression, supporting sustained immune surveillance.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 嵌合抗原受体 (CAR)-T 细胞疗法在胶质母细胞瘤 (GB) 中的疗效有限，很大程度上是由于免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境 (TME)。我们之前已经证明，基于配体的 mCD70 定向构建体 mCAR27 在体外特异性消除 CD70⁺ GB 细胞，并在原位 GB 的同基因模型中诱导持久的肿瘤缓解和延长的生存期。尽管CD70作为GB CAR-T细胞靶标具有治疗前景，但CD70导向的CAR-T细胞在靶标拦截后对脑肿瘤免疫景观的影响仍有待探索。在这里，我们通过进行批量 RNA 测序和体内实验，独立证实了 CD70 在小鼠 GB 中的致瘤作用。接下来，我们应用单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNAseq) 来破译瘤内 mCAR27 治疗后携带 CD70+ GB 的免疫活性小鼠中 GB 浸润免疫细胞的转录组。 CAR-T 细胞治疗扩大了过继转移的细胞，并与内源性 Cd8⁺ T 细胞浸润增加有关，同时减少了免疫抑制细胞群，包括 Tregs 和抗炎性 M2 样巨噬细胞，以及树突状细胞和自然杀伤细胞的亚群。在多个 GB 浸润免疫亚群中检测到 CD70 表达，特别是 Tregs 和 M2 样巨噬细胞。在转录方面，mCAR27介导的GB缓解导致I型干扰素刺激基因和免疫抑制介质（如Arg1、Tgfbi、Cd274、Pdcd1lg2和Lag3）协调下调，同时上调参与炎症消退的基因，这些结果与GB衍生的炎症应激和免疫抑制的减弱一致。总的来说，我们展示了 CD70 导向的 CAR-T 细胞疗法重塑了治疗后免疫景观，以消除炎症并减少免疫抑制，支持持续的免疫监视。

global_hot_topics.abstract: PURPOSE: Clinical features of COPD and asthma overlap, complicating differential diagnosis. This study investigated the prevalence of comorbid asthma in COPD patients and its association with patient-related outcomes. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Patients with a doctor's diagnosis of COPD were randomly selected in two cohorts 2005 (n = 1060) and 2014 (n = 1671), from primary and secondary care in Sweden. Data were collected from medical records and patient questionnaires at baseline and at follow-up (2012 and 2022, respectively). Questionnaires included data on exacerbations. Symptoms were assessed using the clinical COPD questionnaire (CCQ). Comorbid asthma was identified through medical records. Ten-year mortality data were obtained from national registers. Logistic and linear regression assessed associations with patient-reported outcomes; Cox regression was applied for mortality analyses. RESULTS: Comorbid asthma was found in 22% of the 2005 cohort and 9% of the 2014 cohort (p < .001). In both cohorts, it was associated with an increased risk of exacerbations: OR (95% CI) 1.58 (1.07-2.32), p = .02, and 2.20 (1.38-3.52), p < .001, respectively. No associations were found between comorbid asthma and worsening of health status (CCQ). Mortality risk did not differ in the 2005 cohort, HR (95% CI) 0.92 (0.71-1.18), but was lower in the 2014 cohort, HR (95% CI) 0.67 (0.49-0.93), p = .02. CONCLUSION: Comorbid asthma in COPD has changed from 22 to 9%, potentially due to improved diagnostics. Comorbid asthma remains clinically relevant due to its association with an increased exacerbation risk.

global_hot_topics.title: Beyond stroke: atrial fibrillation and the broader burden of thromboembolic events in the population-based EpiHealth study.
global_hot_topics.authors: Pernilla Höiby; Moncef Zarrouk; Lars Lind; Rani Basna; Marie Claire Overton; Sölve Elmståhl
global_hot_topics.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the distribution and risk of thromboembolic events (TEs) among adults with and without atrial fibrillation (AF), and to assess oral anticoagulant (OAC) use over time. DESIGN: This population-based longitudinal cohort study included EpiHealth participants recruited between April 2011 and December 2016 and followed through linkage to Swedish health data registers from baseline until the first TE, death, or December 31, 2016. RESULTS: At baseline, 873 of 22,616 participants (3.9%) had AF and 297 developed incident AF during follow-up. 484 participants experienced at least one TE during 70,587 person-years. Participants with AF had higher TE incidence (68 events, 5.9%; p < 0.001), predominantly arterial (73.5%), with 94% of arterial events involving the cerebral circulation. Approximately one quarter of TEs among participants with AF occurred outside the cerebral circulation and comprised both venous and non-cerebral arterial events. Although participants with incident AF represented less than one quarter of participants with AF, they accounted for 40% of TEs in the AF group. OAC use increased from 39.0% to 50.4%, with a shift from predominantly warfarin to direct oral anticoagulants. In time-dependent Cox regression adjusted for age, sex, and prior arterial thromboembolism, untreated AF was associated with increased thromboembolic risk compared with no AF (HR 2.53), whereas OAC use was associated with lower risk. CONCLUSIONS: AF was associated with substantially increased thromboembolic risk, predominantly arterial in nature. One in five TEs among participants with AF coincided with newly diagnosed AF, suggesting potential opportunities for earlier AF detection and timely initiation of anticoagulant treatment.

global_hot_topics.title: Clinical Outcomes of Partial Injection Underwater Endoscopic Mucosal Resection for Superficial Non-ampullary Duodenal Epithelial Tumors (With Video).
global_hot_topics.authors: Noboru Misawa; Takuma Higurashi; Yuki Asano; Kojiro Inoue; Hitomi Suzuki; Shigeki Tamura; Takashi Kobayashi; Michihiro Iwaki
global_hot_topics.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Although endoscopic resection is widely performed for superficial non-ampullary duodenal epithelial tumors (SNADETs), conventional endoscopic mucosal resection (CEMR) may be associated with suboptimal complete resection rates. Partial injection underwater EMR (PI-UEMR) has been proposed to improve the visualization of distal lesion margins and facilitate en bloc resection. We aimed to evaluate the outcomes of PI-UEMR for SNADETs, using CEMR as a historical institutional comparator. METHODS: This single-center observational cohort study included patients who underwent endoscopic mucosal resection for SNADETs between September 2015 and December 2025. Lesions treated with CEMR or PI-UEMR were analyzed. The primary outcomes were en bloc and R0 resection rates. The secondary outcomes included histological diagnosis and procedure-related adverse events, including intraoperative perforation, delayed perforation, and delayed bleeding. RESULTS: In total, 77 lesions in 73 patients were analyzed, including 39 treated with CEMR and 38 treated with PI-UEMR. The en bloc resection rates were 90.0% and 97.4% in the CEMR and PI-UEMR groups, respectively. The R0 resection rate was significantly higher in the PI-UEMR group than in the CEMR group (89.4% vs. 69.2%). Histological diagnoses were similar between the groups. No intraoperative perforation occurred in either group. No procedure-related adverse events, including delayed perforation or bleeding, were observed in the PI-UEMR group. CONCLUSIONS: While maintaining a favorable safety profile, PI-UEMR was associated with a higher R0 resection rate than CEMR in this study. It may represent an effective endoscopic treatment option for SNADETs, particularly when precise visualization of the distal lesion margins is required. UNLABELLED: Trial Registration: University Hospital Medical Information Network: UMIN000060637.

global_hot_topics.title: The genetic landscape of RAG deficiency: Novel and founder variants in a large Algerian cohort.
global_hot_topics.authors: Brahim Belaid; Koon-Wing Chan; Jennifer Stoddard; Julie Niemela; Heather Kenney; Adriana A De Jesus; Daniel Leung; Jing Yang
global_hot_topics.abstract: RAG1/RAG2 deficiency causes diverse SCID phenotypes, but large, systematically characterized cohorts from North Africa remain lacking. We retrospectively characterized 128 confirmed RAG1/RAG2-deficient patients diagnosed over 14 years in Algeria, classified per PIDTC 2022 criteria. Consanguinity was high (70.3%), with RAG2 (57.0%) outnumbering RAG1 (43.0%), a reversal of patterns reported elsewhere. Classical SCID (61.0%) and Omenn syndrome (23.4%) predominated. Two candidate founder variants (RAG1 c.519del, RAG2 c.104G>T) accounted for 76.6% of genotypes, yet identical c.519del genotypes produced three discordant phenotypes. Four novel variants and four digenic/oligogenic cases broadened the molecular spectrum. Despite a short diagnostic delay, mortality was 89.1%, driven primarily by near-absent HSCT access (2.3%). This study expands the molecular and clinical spectrum of RAG deficiency in an underrepresented population, revealing a reversed RAG1/RAG2 ratio and phenotypic heterogeneity despite shared founder genotypes. These findings prioritize functional validation of uncertain-significance variants and underscore the need for NBS and expanded transplant access to translate diagnosis into survival.

global_hot_topics.title: Characterizing hypertension in activated PI3K delta syndrome: Findings from Epic Cosmos.
global_hot_topics.authors: Brianna Santiago; Jennifer Keelin; Xiaoqi Sun; Christopher Chang
global_hot_topics.abstract: APDS is a rare inborn error of immunity with comorbidity patterns that have yet to be characterized at a large scale. Using Epic Cosmos, a de-identified electronic health record database, we conducted a retrospective, cross-sectional analysis of 866 patients identified by structured diagnosis codes (ICD-10: D84.81; SNOMED: 793412000). Findings revealed that hypertension was coded as affecting 28.5% of the cohort, with age-stratified analyses demonstrating higher prevalence among younger APDS patients compared with age-matched non-APDS peers. Among patients aged ≤50 years, hypertension prevalence was 24.05% in the APDS group compared with 10.89% in the age-matched non-APDS population (prevalence ratio 2.21, 95% CI, 1.90-2.57, P < 0.0001). This association remained prominent in a more specific APDS sensitivity cohort in which the base population required an APDS diagnosis, alongside an allergy and immunology encounter. The findings of this paper provide large-scale characterization of APDS and identify hypertension, particularly among younger APDS patients, as a potentially underrecognized comorbidity that warrants further investigation.

medical_news.title: Mayo Clinic discovers new ways to fight the “zombie” cells that drive aging
medical_news.abstract: Mayo Clinic scientists have uncovered surprising new insights into “zombie cells,” aging cells that linger in the body and contribute to inflammation and disease. Seven studies reveal why these cells are harmful and identify new strategies for targeting them, including a natural compound found in tomatoes. In aging mice, experimental treatments reduced inflammation and improved physical and brain health. The findings could open the door to therapies that combat some of the biological processes behind aging.
